subjects.crate: One sturdy square carved dark walnut treasure crate obstacle viewed almost straight on with a little top and right side visible. Thick heavy antique gold iron corner brackets and two gold reinforcement straps, deep sculpted Slavic floral carvings, navy-black crevices, strong warm wood contrast. Clearly a destructible wooden blocker, not a reward chest: no lid opening, no treasure, no gems. Compact square silhouette.
subjects.ice: One chunky square slab of translucent frosted blue-white glacier ice, irregular chipped polygon corners, thick bevelled edges, a few deep branching cracks inside and a frosted opaque core. Clearly a solid ice obstacle, not a blue match gem. Outer crystalline edges bright cyan/white, interior partially translucent so a gem under the sprite remains legible. Square silhouette; no gem, no frame, no metallic objects.
subjects.chain: One square dark navy lacquer plate trapped by two heavy crossed dark iron chains and a large centrally hanging antique-bronze padlock with a sapphire keyhole. Chunky readable links and rust-gold edge highlights, worn engraved Slavic ornament on the padlock. Clearly a locked chain obstacle. Strong compact square silhouette.
subjects.seal: One square mystical runic seal obstacle: a thick antique-gold engraved octagonal frame fitted within a square silhouette, around a solid midnight navy stone tablet with a single large brilliant sapphire-blue branching rune carved in its center. A few restrained cyan light fissures through the stone, substantial sculpted volume, weathered gold corners, unmistakable sealed magic barrier. No letters or words, no numerals. Strong recognizable compact silhouette.

shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite for a luxurious Russian fairy tale match-3 game. Painterly 3D hand-rendered material, rich local contrast and readable at 64 pixels, cohesive dark navy/antique gold/sapphire family. A single isolated object centered in a square canvas with 12 percent transparent margin all around, no ground plane or cast shadow, no scenery, no badge, no text, no watermark, no extra objects. True transparent alpha background. Original design, not copied from another game.
